# Oracle conformance fixtures

`rob-authorization.json` contains a complete signed ROB request, V4 payment token, HTML creative with matching pixel URL, refund-key commitment, output signing data, and NIP-98 header. It is generated by `test/fixture.ts` using public deterministic test keys and time `1800000000`. Its proof signatures are synthetic: it exercises the oracle's local authorization boundary, not mint authenticity or settlement. Tests independently construct the Cashu digest and verify both spending signatures.

`cashu-sig-all.json` copies the five P2PK swap JSON examples from [Cashu NUT-11's official vectors at 8f244be801a7de5811bd230cc4bc78439f4948dc](https://github.com/cashubtc/nuts/blob/8f244be801a7de5811bd230cc4bc78439f4948dc/tests/11-test.md#sig_all-test-vectors). This includes the mixed-condition example: its signature verifies mathematically but the conditions would not be valid together. These are signing vectors, not all valid ROB payments. The published first digest is retained verbatim. Melt vectors are excluded from the oracle's swap-only scope.
